summary.zh: 交付前生成评审页面，卡住未签核的改动
summary.en: Build a review page and block release until a named reviewer signs off

description.zh: 为需要人签字的交付物生成评审页面，列出待确认项与阻塞问题，没有具名评审人就不会放行。适合上线前的方案、规格、报告、数据迁移，以及其他不可逆操作。评审页面需要在浏览器中打开，脚本需要本地 Python 环境。
description.en: Builds a review page for anything that needs sign-off, listing open questions and blockers, and refuses to close while a blocker is open or no reviewer is named. Review pages open in a browser; the scripts need local Python.
